title: AisleIconMap
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/AisleIconMap.swift` with a static function (or dictionary) mapping lowercased aisle names to SF Symbol names. Use the spec's mapping table: produce→`leaf.fill`, herbs→`leaf`, meat/meat & fish/seafood→`fish.fill`, dairy/cheese/eggs→`drop.fill`, bakery→`birthday.cake.fill`, pantry→`archivebox.fill`, canned→`cylinder.fill`, frozen→`snowflake`, spices→`flame.fill`, pasta/rice/flours→`fork.knife`, oils→`drop.degreesign`, nuts→`circle.grid.cross.fill`, sauces/juices/world→`mug.fill`, baking→`oven`, alko→`wineglass.fill`. Unknown/nil falls back to `basket.fill`. The dev agent may substitute a more appropriate iOS 17 SF Symbol for any individual entry.
acceptance_criteria: All 15 aisle categories from the spec table have an entry
nil and unknown aisle names return `basket.fill`
All SF Symbol names used exist in iOS 17 (no custom assets)

SF Symbol names follow the spec table verbatim; all confirmed present in iOS 17.
